name: STR
description: When your overall fitness and physicality is tested. STR helps resist forced movement,restraint, poison, and extreme temperatures.

name: DEX
description: When your agility or speed is tested. DEX helps you dive for cover in an explosion or stay on your feet while running across icy terrain.

name: INT
description: When your intelligence is tested. INT helps you see though tricks and illusions.

name: WIL
description: When your courage or personality is tested. WIL helps you resist charm or fear effects.
